correctness.rationale: The pointwise back condition is equivalent to full successor-cone image equality. The child-case partition (some child hits target root versus none, forcing a permutation of immediate target children) is exhaustive, disjoint, and multiplicative. Idempotence forces fixation of the entire image cone and the spine and gives independent off-spine p-morphism choices. Arbitrary finite d,h are covered by induction; independent brute force of 826953 small functions matches the exact rank polynomials, but finite tests are not a proof.

value.rationale: This is a complete finite-frame morphism enumeration for a canonical family in modal semantics. Every possible image size, count of morphisms at that rank, idempotent retraction counts and an algebraic modal dual are computed uniformly for all arities and heights. The non-surjective and idempotent strata are mathematically invisible to the previously known wreath-product automorphism count; concrete seven-world results provide a nontrivial test case.
